description: Source code for the UrlContentFetcher class, which uses Puppeteer to fetch web page content and convert it to Markdown, including browser management and error handling.

classes.name: UrlContentFetcher
classes.description: A class that manages a headless browser instance to fetch web page content and convert it to Markdown.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the UrlContentFetcher with a VSCode extension context.

methods.name: ensureChromiumExists

methods.description: Launches a Puppeteer browser instance with specific arguments and configurations.

methods.name: urlToMarkdown
